scanner.definition: Cursor.value skips ASCII whitespace before start; start is first value byte ({ for a Feature), end one past final }; no surrounding whitespace. Byte-order mark before collection is rejected. RS sequence start excludes RS, end excludes required LF. Strict UTF-8 parses each value.
scanner.reuse: exported readStreamingFeatures accepts Readable.from([originalBuffer]) without a job; sourceRecord supplies rawSha256. Use same scanner, unchanged.

import.bytes: direct input.bytes held throughout; retained manual path reads whole and verifies receipt before passing validated.bytes and retainedOriginal pin; ingestArea independently computes digest and checks pinned SHA
import.pairing: normalizer enumerates original rows before geometry quarantine/continue; sourceFeatureIndex retains array index, not accepted ordinal. Compare each normalized properties/sourceGeometry with scanner feature; any mismatch or framing failure discards all locators.
